async def act(page):
    # Set Period to 'Month'
    period_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Period")
    await period_combobox.select_option("Month")
    
    # Set From date to Feb 1, 2022
    from_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="From *")
    await from_textbox.fill("02/01/2022")
    
    # Set To date to Nov 30, 2022
    to_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="To *")
    await to_textbox.fill("11/30/2022")
    
    # Set Order Status to 'Specified' to filter for successful orders
    order_status_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Order Status")
    await order_status_combobox.select_option("Specified")
    
    # Click the 'Show Report' button to generate the report
    show_report_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Show Report")
    await show_report_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the report to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Additional wait for dynamic content
    
    # Locate the table containing the report data
    tables = page.get_by_role("table")
    report_table = tables.nth(1)  # Assume the second table is the report table
    
    # Get all rows in the report table
    rows = report_table.get_by_role("row")
    row_count = await rows.count()
    
    # Prepare to collect monthly data
    monthly_data = []
    for i in range(row_count):
        row = rows.nth(i)
        cells = row.get_by_role("cell")
        cell_count = await cells.count()
        if cell_count >= 2:  # Assuming first cell is month, second is count
            month_cell = cells.nth(0)
            count_cell = cells.nth(1)
            month_text = await month_cell.text_content()
            count_text = await count_cell.text_content()
            if month_text is not None and count_text is not None:
                month_text = month_text.strip()
                count_text = count_text.strip()
                # Format month as two-digit MM
                month_map = {
                    'January': '01', 'February': '02', 'March': '03', 'April': '04',
                    'May': '05', 'June': '06', 'July': '07', 'August': '08',
                    'September': '09', 'October': '10', 'November': '11', 'December': '12'
                }
                month_num = month_map.get(month_text, month_text)
                if isinstance(month_num, str) and month_num.isdigit() and len(month_num) == 1:
                    month_num = f'0{month_num}'
                monthly_data.append(f"{month_num}:{count_text}")
    
    # Output the collected data as a string with each pair on a new line
    result = '\n'.join(monthly_data)
    return result
